research_threads.name: astra-core-boundaries
research_threads.question: Component, deployment, persistence and trust boundaries
research_threads.result: Endpoint classification replaces token/org path gates. Separate API/web/worker/MCP/AgentHost. Provider-selected stores and resource roles remain API authority.

research_threads.name: astra-core-flows
research_threads.question: Request/data/control-flow directions
research_threads.result: Startup is not a request hop. Requests traverse integrity/authentication/authorization, then handler resource checks and delegation. Local snapshots and durable-provider subscriptions are separate.

research_threads.name: astra-core-assurance
research_threads.question: Representations, lifecycle failures and assurance limits
research_threads.result: Do not infer production compatibility from fixture keys, universal workflow traversal from legacy tests, or worker-exclusive execution from deployment labels. Retire the duplicate handler picture only after consumer migration.
